name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 38 - Am 60
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 38b. Recalls that the daily allowance is a flat-rate sum covering accommodation, meals and related expenses each day that a Member is present at Parliament on official business; stresses that Members must sign an attendance register in order to benefit from it; notes that there are exemptions for the President and the chairs of political groups who automatically benefit from it independently of their presence unless they explicitly request it; calls on the Parliament to put an end to the exceptions for the President and the chairs of political groups, who should sign an attendance register like all other Members to benefit from their per-diem;
